entity_raw.definition_raw:
You’ve developed your skills at picking up items while on the move.

Prerequisite(s): Deft Hands, Sleight of Hand 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): You no longer take the –20 penalty for attempting a Sleight of Hand check as a move action. You can attempt a Sleight of Hand check as a standard action in the middle of your move action.

Normal: You can attempt a Sleight of Hand check as a move action only by taking a –20 penalty on the check.
